dynamic-models-discovery.title: Dynamic /models discovery (OpenRouter + Other) with namespaced cache
dynamic-models-discovery.description: Replace hardcoded model list for OPENROUTER and OTHER with on-demand GET /models discovery + local cache + searchable grouped picker. Single ModelDiscovery.kt with field-priority reader (display_name|name|id; context_length|context_size|top_provider; CHAT-only API; supportsVision defaults false unless upstream modality declares image; sanitize+cap displayName at 80 chars; **mandatory tool-calling filter (drops ~26% of OpenRouter)**; filter non-chat by upstream model_type/endpoints/modality preferred, id substring fallback). Cache to filesDir/model_discovery_cache.json keyed by {provider.name}:{normalizedBaseUrl}; **slim before persist** (only ModelEntry fields, no pricing/description — ~440KB → ~30KB). Discovered entries are namespaced {provider.name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)}:{modelId} so they cannot collide with seed entries; modelId rejected if it contains whitespace or starts with :/ . Catalog only surfaces discovered entries whose cache key baseUrl matches the current effective baseUrl for that provider (prevents sending current key to stale URL). Refresh button per provider in settings, disabled when prerequisites missing (key for OPENROUTER; key+url for OTHER), shows spinner+timestamp+error inline. **Picker UX: search box + group by id prefix (anthropic/openai/google pinned) + sort by created desc within group + auto-scroll+expand selected** — required because OpenRouter returns 263 tool-capable models. ModelCatalogRepository.refresh is suspend. OPENAI_API/OPENAI_CODEX/LOCAL_LFM keep curated JSON seed (upstream /models too thin; LiteLLM as third-party source considered + rejected for now).

custom-endpoint-ui-glue.title: Sub 1c: OTHER UI + preflight + intent + eval + docs (user-visible)
custom-endpoint-ui-glue.description: Wire OTHER end-to-end so users can configure and run it. Settings Other tab UI (Base URL + Custom model id + API Key fields with debounced persist; auto-flip selectedModel=other-custom when all three valid AND user is in OTHER tab AND repo.catalog contains the synth entry — order matters to dodge race). findMissingCloudKeys short-circuits on selectedModel==other-custom (returns missing entries for any blank/invalid of key/url/modelId with field-level message in MissingCredentialTarget). ensureRequiredCredentials in SessionLlmBootstrapper does the same before catalog.resolve. SettingsDeepLink gains provider: LLMProvider? field; ChatViewModel + SettingsSheet propagate it. Intent extras EXTRA_OTHER_API_KEY/EXTRA_OTHER_BASE_URL/EXTRA_OTHER_MODEL_ID added; MainActivityIntentApplier writes them AND calls repo.invalidate() afterward. scripts/debug-run.sh forwards OTHER_API_KEY/OTHER_BASE_URL/OTHER_MODEL_ID env vars. eval/aw_bridge/native_agent_bridge.py forwards as intent extras. eval/aw_bridge/runner.py preflight rejects other-custom run when any of the trio missing. doc/main/app/settings.md + doc/main/infra/llm.md updated to reflect OTHER provider.
